definition.original_file_sha256: SHA256 of the original NPY file bytes
definition.reference_full_pcm_sha256: SHA256 of all decoded samples converted to little-endian float64, C-order PCM bytes without header
definition.reference_common_prefix_pcm_sha256: Same PCM encoding for samples [0, common_samples), using the original fixed input-manifest prefix
definition.loading: numpy.load(..., allow_pickle=False); no alignment, gain adjustment, clipping or resynthesis
